name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new customization provider, GNOME extension manifest, or improvement for macKali
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: realmadede
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see in macKali.

## Use Case / Problem Statement
Why is this feature useful for Kali Linux GNOME users? Which workflow or visual element does it improve?

## Proposed Implementation
Describe how this should work:
- Which preset (`minimal`, `balanced`, `full`, or opt-in flag) should include it?
- Does it work rootlessly within `$HOME` (`~/.config` / `~/.local/share`)?
- Does it support both **Wayland** and **X11** sessions on GNOME Shell?
- How should `./scripts/uninstall.sh` cleanly reverse the change?

## Additional Context
Add any reference links, upstream repositories, or screenshots here.
